title: Conectores avanzados de discurso y elipsis

lesson.intro: La cohesion es lo que hace que un texto se lea como un todo y no como frases sueltas. Se consigue con conectores precisos (que marcan contraste, adicion, consecuencia, ejemplo...) y con elipsis y sustitucion, que evitan repetir lo que ya se entiende.

sections.heading: 1 - Conectores de contraste
sections.body:
however, nevertheless, nonetheless (mas formal), still, all the same, then again introducen una idea que choca con la anterior (al principio, con coma).

whereas / while contrastan dos hechos en una misma frase. albeit + frase (no clausula) = 'aunque'. notwithstanding = 'a pesar de' (+ nombre). that said / having said that = 'dicho esto'.
examples: It's slow; however, it's reliable.
She loves cats, whereas he prefers dogs.
He agreed, albeit reluctantly.
Notwithstanding the delays, it finished on time.

sections.heading: 2 - Conectores de adicion y secuencia
sections.body:
moreover, furthermore, in addition, what is more, on top of that, besides suman un punto (a menudo mas fuerte).

likewise / similarly marcan un paralelismo. Secuencia: firstly, secondly, then, subsequently, finally, ultimately (= al final / en el fondo).
examples: It's small. Moreover, it's far from the station.
The report is late. On top of that, several figures are wrong.
The results were poor; similarly, attendance dropped.
Ultimately, the decision is yours.

sections.heading: 3 - Conectores de causa y consecuencia
sections.body:
consequently, therefore, hence, thus, accordingly, as a result introducen el efecto (al principio, con coma).

owing to / due to / because of + nombre; because / since / as / given (that) + clausula. thereby + -ing = 'y asi...'. hence + nombre ('hence the delay').
examples: Sales fell sharply. Consequently, the factory closed.
The road was closed; therefore, we took a detour.
The bridge was damaged, thereby closing the main route.
Due to the storm, all flights were cancelled.

sections.heading: 4 - Ejemplo y reformulacion
sections.body: for example / for instance / such as / e.g. dan muestras. namely / viz. dan la lista completa y concreta. i.e. / that is (to say) / in other words reformulan. to be precise / or rather afinan o corrigen. in short / put simply resumen.
examples: Only one option remains, namely to resign.
It's obsolete, i.e. no longer supported.
The main issue, that is, funding, remains.
It failed - or rather, it was never really tried.

sections.heading: 5 - Concesion y enfasis
sections.body:
admittedly, granted, to be fair, arguably conceden que la otra parte tiene razon o suavizan una afirmacion.

indeed, in fact refuerzan (o, in fact, corrigen suavemente). if anything = 'mas bien lo contrario'. needless to say = 'ni que decir tiene'. let alone (tras negativa) = 'y mucho menos'. by and large = 'en general'.
examples: Admittedly, the design has flaws, but it works.
It's cheap; indeed, it's the cheapest available.
If anything, the problem has got worse.
He can't walk, let alone run.

sections.heading: 6 - Elipsis verbal
sections.body:
Se omite el verbo o la frase que ya se entiende: I can and I will (help); She said she'd call, and she did; "Do you smoke?" "I do"; I'd love to (come).

Tras comparativos: He works harder than she does / than I do. Con modales: He must have (arrived) by now.
examples: I can help, and I will.
She said she would call, and she did.
"Do you like jazz?" "I do."
I'd love to come but I can't.

sections.heading: 7 - Sustitucion
sections.body:
so / not sustituyen una clausula tras think, hope, believe, expect, suppose, be afraid ("I think so", "I'm afraid not"). doubt / know llevan it ("I doubt it").

one / ones sustituyen un sustantivo contable. do (does/did) sustituye un verbo. the former / the latter = el primero / el segundo de dos cosas mencionadas.
examples: "Is it going to rain?" "I think so."
"Did they win?" "I'm afraid not."
The red shoes are nicer than the black ones.
Of the two, I prefer the former.

sections.heading: 8 - Elegir el mecanismo de cohesion
sections.body:
Identifica la relacion logica: contraste → however / whereas / nevertheless; adicion → moreover / furthermore; consecuencia → consequently / therefore / hence; ejemplo → for instance / such as; especificacion → namely; reformulacion → in other words / i.e.

Comprueba la forma: due to + nombre, albeit + frase, conector al principio + coma. Usa elipsis y sustitucion para no repetir.
examples: Poor results. Consequently, funding was cut. (consecuencia)
Poor results. Nevertheless, the team stayed positive. (contraste)
One solution, namely a recount. (especificacion)

contrast.title: Que conector para que relacion
rows: moreover, furthermore, in addition, what is more
i.e., that is, in other words

mistakes: NO: Due to it was late, we left. -> SI: Because it was late... / Due to the late hour...
NO: Albeit he was tired, he continued. -> SI: Although he was tired... / He continued, albeit reluctantly.
NO: However the price, we bought it. -> SI: However, we bought it. / Despite the price, we bought it.
NO: I think yes. -> SI: I think so.
NO: I'm afraid no. -> SI: I'm afraid not.
NO: The red shoes are better than the black one. -> SI: ... than the black ones.
NO: 'Namely' antes de ejemplos sueltos. -> Usa namely para una lista completa; para muestras, e.g. / such as.
